'''''Vanquisher''''' was the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Borun Call]]'s [[Sydon Vehicle Works]] [[MRX-BR Pacifier]]. It served as the flagship of his slaving fleet.
